payload.title: Orbital-scale variability over the last 1.5 Ma
payload.description: This workflow explores the orbital-scale variability over the last 1.5 million years using high-resolution stable oxygen isotope records from IODP Site U1385. It employs the Pyleoclim library for spectral, wavelet, and coherence analyses, and uses the pangaeapy package to access datasets from PANGAEA. The workflow compares planktonic and benthic records, performs coherence analysis, and examines the relationship between millennial-scale climate variability and orbital forcing. It also utilizes the climlab library to compute insolation curves for further analysis.
